title: AMC 8 Practice: Counting Strings on a Grid — Can X Stay Ahead?
description:
AMC 8 practice problem on counting arrangements of X and O tiles where X never falls behind, solved by listing and by a grid walk. (Level 5 of 5)
Four X's and four O's: in how many strings does X never fall behind? Vantee solves it two ways, with an organized list and then a walk on a grid where you just add numbers, shows why the wrong answers are tempting, and gives you a twist to try yourself.
